title: 长度最小的子数组
description: 给定一个正整数数组 nums 与正整数 target，找出其中和 ≥ target 的最短连续子数组并返回其长度。如果不存在则返回 0。

examples.explanation: 7 个数 target=7; [4,3] 长度 2 即满足。

ioFormat: 第一行 n target（空格分隔）,第二行 n 个整数。输出最短长度。

solutions.idea: 枚举起点 i,扩展终点 j 直到 sum ≥ target。O(n²) 时间，n=10^5 时超时。
滑动窗口:左 l、右 r 都单调右移,sum≥target 时记录最短再缩左边界。O(n) 时间。
solutions.code:
import sys

def min_len_opt(nums, target):
    n = len(nums)
    best = 0
    s = 0
    l = 0
    for r in range(n):
        s += nums[r]
        while s >= target:
            cur = r - l + 1
            if best == 0 or cur < best: best = cur
            s -= nums[l]
            l += 1
    return best

if __name__ == '__main__':
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        sys.exit(0)
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = list(map(int, data[2:2 + n]))
    target = int(data[1])
    print(min_len_opt(nums, target))

solutions.idea: 前缀和 + 二分:在前缀和数组上找对 (i, j),使 sum[j]-sum[i] ≥ target 即 sum[j] ≥ target + sum[i]。对每个 j,二分 i。O(n log n) 时间。
solutions.code:
import sys
from bisect import bisect_left

def min_len_best(nums, target):
    n = len(nums)
    ps = [0]
    for x in nums:
        ps.append(ps[-1] + x)
    best = 0
    for j in range(1, n + 1):
        need = target + ps[j - 1] if False else None
        # Need: ps[i] <= ps[j] - target
        i = bisect_left(ps, ps[j] - target + 1) - 1
        # Actually we want smallest i s.t. ps[j] - ps[i] >= target, equiv. ps[i] <= ps[j] - target
        i = bisect_left(ps, ps[j] - target + 1) - 1
        # 重写：bisect_left 找第一个 >= ps[j] - target + 1 的位置 i，ps[i-1] <= ps[j]-target
        i = bisect_left(ps, ps[j] - target + 1) - 1
        if i >= 0:
            cur = j - i
            if best == 0 or cur < best:
                best = cur
    return best

if __name__ == '__main__':
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        sys.exit(0)
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = list(map(int, data[2:2 + n]))
    target = int(data[1])
    print(min_len_best(nums, target))
